description: Horários em Tempo Real - Autocarros is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Município de Castelo Branco. Information of the real-time schedules of the buses and their location, of all lines and stops, of the municipality of Castelo Branco. Coverage: Município de Castelo Branco. The portal shows the English title as "Timetables in Real Time - Buses" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Município de Castelo Branco. Its keywords include transportes-publicos. The listing shows 1 download or service links in URL. The listing shows 2025-10-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
